title: A hangup mid-check with no request ever made -> NO_ACTION, not a silent PENDING
description: The caller identifies and then the line goes dead: an SSO check was kicked off but never returned, and 48 seconds pass (past seed.thresholds.tool_timeout_ms = 45000) with no further audio and no request ever stated. Rule 3 (no request) alone would just hold at PENDING; invariant I4 additionally treats a tool that never returned past the timeout as an incomplete evaluation, and since there is no open request to route to a human, I4 downgrades the outcome to NO_ACTION rather than leaving it open-endedly PENDING or (as amendment §E's one-line description names it) escalating. FINDING (see task-6-report.md): the amendment text also expects required_actions to include a "low-priority" open_incident; requiredActions() only ever populates for STAGE/FREEZE/ESCALATE verdicts, so a NO_ACTION file carries required_actions: [] in the real engine -- recorded here as an intentional design property, not silently matched to the brief's wording.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is Dana Whitfield, corporate treasury.

actions.detail: caller line disconnected -- no further audio
